reasons.text: Then he opened the new season with eight goals in eight games, including a brace in defeat to Real Madrid. 5) Erling Haaland – 25 goals A goal against Sunderland before the international break not only took Haaland to 20 for the calendar year, but also meant he ticked off a rare blank on his CV.

Enzo Fernandez wasted another chance to double City’s lead when he ballooned over a 25-yard free kick, but that proved to be the last reprieve the Tractor Boys were handed, as Haaland burst through the heart of the visitors’ defence to cooly slot home City’s third and all but end the game as a contest.

After completing 90 minutes in Man City's 4-2 loss to Paris Saint-Germain in the Champions League, Enzo Maresca suggested that Haaland could be dropped from the starting lineup at home to the Tractor Boys.
